definition: נְשָׂא verb lift, take, carry (compare Biblical Hebrew; rare in Aramaic; see נְסִי , נְסָא ChWB , NHWB ); — Pe`al Perfect 3 masculine singular ׳ נ Dan 2:35 carry away (of wind, with accusative of thing); Imperative masculine singular שֵׂא Ezra 5:15 take (accusative vessels). Hithpa. make a rising, an insurrection: Participle feminine singular מִתְנַשְּׂאָה Ezra 4:19 , עַל person נְשֵׁיהוֺן see [ נָשִׁין ] below II. אנשׁ .
